title: What You Get — Domain, Hosting & Updates
description: Everything that comes with a site built by Jude Hill: domain, hosting, SSL, backups, and maintenance. No lock-in — you own the site.

blocks.headline: What comes in a website
blocks.subheadline: Domain, server, certificate, backups, updates — here's the whole list.

items.title: Your domain
items.description: A domain you own. I handle the renewals and settings.

items.title: Managed hosting
items.description: Runs on my server. Nothing for you to configure.

items.title: Backups
items.description: Anything breaks, I roll it back.

items.title: Email / Phone
items.description: My personal email and phone number.

blocks.text: Already have one? Great, we'll use it. Don't have one yet? I'll help you find the perfect name for your business, and if it's available, we can get it.
Each site runs in its own isolated container on a server I maintain. Patches, certificates, and monitoring are all handled overnight without downtime.
I charge my hourly rate. For small things, it's just added onto the next invoice. For bigger things, we talk through the scope.
These are static HTML sites; you pay for my expertise to keep them up. If there are new bugs or the server gets hacked, I deal with it, and you don't have to worry about anything.

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: We start with an idea and then work from there.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: If I have all the information, it can take as little as a week. The part that takes the longest is figuring out what you truly want and how we can get all the info together to make those dreams come true.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside Eugene?
items.answer: Yes. I am based in Eugene and work throughout Springfield and Lane County, and I take remote projects anywhere.

items.question: Do I own the website?
items.answer: You own the domain. It is hosted under my name, but I will transfer it if you move. You own the website; I will send you a copy of the code if you ever want to move. I own the rights to reference your site as example work at any time.

items.question: Do you use WordPress, Squarespace or Wix?
items.answer: No. Every site is static HTML. That is why they load fast and why there is no plugin stack to keep patched, and nothing that breaks when a theme or plugin gets updated or discontinued.

items.question: What do you need from me to get started?
items.answer: Any information, from pictures to themes to site maps.
